Ok it worked locally, thanks! I'll push it now and see if its good here
That would be worth investigating closer and seeing why this can be `nullptr` here, but I think this is a reasonable check in this scope

This can't be the solution, `scene` code shouldn't depend on `editor`. Nodes communicate with the editor using property hints and usage hints, or virtual methods, not by calling into the editor directly.

I'm not sure what would be a better way of doing this, but this isn't the right approach.

Ok, I'll try with just property / usage hints then. Does this sound ok:

A new usage hint, PROPERTY_USAGE_GROUP_MERGE. When a group / subgroup has this flag, it would merge into the next group / subgroup with the same name.

For implementation, I think it could add to a hashmap of property_name to `EditorPropertySection`. And when a later group matches the name, it takes all the child properties from the old section, and then either deletes or hides the old section

Edit: Maybe it could also be nice to have 2 usage hints, for adding to the beginning or end of the group?
Weird. It builds and runs fine locally in mono but not here. Regardless it seems I shouldn't be doing it this way anyways, so I'll start redoing it with usage hints
